label: Zero-to-One Visionary
shortDescription: You create what does not yet exist. You see possibility before structure and optimize for breakthrough value and direction-setting clarity.
risks: May move on before depth is achieved
growthPath: Learning to stay long enough to see systems mature.

label: Systems Thinker (Experience Architect)
shortDescription: You bring coherence to complexity. You design for scalability, logical architecture, and long-term integrity.
risks: Can appear slow in scrappy contexts
growthPath: Balancing system integrity with rapid experimentation.

label: Growth & Optimization Designer
shortDescription: You improve measurable outcomes. You see funnels, levers, and behavioral triggers and optimize for activation, retention, and conversion.
growthPath: Connecting experimentation to larger narrative and strategy.

label: Craft Purist
shortDescription: You elevate quality and emotional resonance. You notice the subtlety others overlook and optimize for detail, clarity, and aesthetic integrity.
risks: Can feel demoralized in low-maturity orgs
growthPath: Knowing when "good enough" creates more impact than perfect.

label: Evidence-Driven Researcher
shortDescription: You understand before acting. You search for truth beneath assumptions and optimize for insight depth and validated learning.
risks: Can feel uncomfortable with intuition-based leaps

label: Design Operator
shortDescription: You make excellence repeatable. You see friction in systems—not just products—and optimize for consistency, workflow clarity, and scalable quality.
risks: May appear bureaucratic in small teams

label: Embedded Strategic Partner
shortDescription: You influence product direction at a systemic level. You connect design to business strategy and optimize for alignment and long-term leverage.
risks: Can over-index on influence vs output
growthPath: Maintaining craft depth alongside strategic reach.
